notes: modis = Terra+Aqua observed; raw_sum = MODIS + S-NPP + NOAA-20 + NOAA-21; harmonized = product (MODIS to 2011, Calember from VIIRS from 2020) with 2012-2019 from the cross-fitted model alone (independent of the region's MODIS); product = the harmonized product itself (h_count) in every month, used for record totals.
